implemented_candidate.source_state: Dirty working-tree candidate: base revision plus the bounded post-verdict fallback in opt/search.go and compiler/native_search.go. Not an unmodified HEAD build.
implemented_candidate.measurement_stage: Initial candidate measurement before independent-review follow-up. The subsequent rank tie-break and strict generic budget corrections are recorded separately; these hashes identify the exact initial build, not the final integrated compiler.
implemented_candidate.policy: At most one additional proposal per function after a Trusted/Witnessed validation, only while a non-identity validation slot remains. The native driver clones only AArch64 blocked-fill rotated configurations, drops rotation, retains downstream flags, and sends the new body through the ordinary materialization, deduplication, checker, cost, and semantic-verifier pipeline. No recursive fallback or expanded validation budget.
implemented_candidate.command: Same baseline emitter/environment, with output stem /private/tmp/oak-stage2-baseline.WI5JCV/stage2-candidate; no OAK_OPT_SKIP or OAK_NATIVE_ONLY settings.
implemented_candidate.all_other_bodies: Their encoded instruction words are unchanged; object addresses shift with the two smaller bodies.
implemented_candidate.artifact_comparison: These before/after sizes use the same companion-object boundary, unlike the older hosted-single-object comparison above.
implemented_candidate.control_note: The global-no-rotation diagnostic has the same counts but is not byte-identical: its independently searched reset uses a different arithmetic configuration. The implemented candidate does not globally disable rotation.
implemented_candidate.conformance_command: Same unchanged harness/shim/cache flags as baseline, substituting newly emitted stage2-candidate.c and stage2-candidate.o, with a separate conformance output binary.

independent_review_followup.equal_outcome_selection: Both Search's local best candidate and the artifact chooser now use final ordered-frontier rank on equal verdict strength. This allows a cheaper post-verdict candidate to beat its previously validated parent while preserving identity-last policy.
independent_review_followup.strict_validation_budget: Post-loop gated recovery skips any unvalidated ungated candidate once the budget is exhausted, choosing an already validated candidate such as the reserved identity. This also closes the pre-existing extra-validation case without a dynamic proposal.
regressions: Trusted and Witnessed parent cost5, fallback cost3, and equal-outcome identity choose the fallback, independent of validation chronology.
Identity remains last on equal verdict strength even when its static cost is1.
Budget3 with two trusted gated candidates and an unvalidated ungated fallback validates only those two plus identity, never a fourth body.
The older ungated-selection test now explicitly allocates budget4 for the four validations it historically expected.
independent_review_followup.integrated_pilot_measurement: Pending final integration/rebase at the time of this review record; do not relabel the initial dirty-build hashes as final-source measurements.

next_optimization.proposal: Preserve an unrotated blocked-fill alternative through scheduling, allocation, callee-save trimming, and redundant-guard elimination when a cheaper rotated sibling fails verification.
next_optimization.evidence: The same compiler and source already prove the 128-instruction unrotated alloc_table with rotation withheld, versus the default 153-instruction fallback. This indicates a candidate-search opportunity; the exact pruning mechanism has not been proved here.
boundaries: Keep normal rotation available elsewhere; do not globally disable it as the implementation.
Require the existing semantic verifier to prove each newly selected body; do not turn the rejected rotated verdict into an admission.
Retain ordered scalar STRs and individual record-field guards; do not infer STP authority or consolidate partial-failure guards from final-state equality.
Validate byte-store effects, trap prefixes, invalid inputs, and the unchanged native differential suite before changing selection.
next_optimization.remaining: The original rotated blocked-fill candidate still lacks a proof. This change recovers independently proven unrotated downstream work; it does not repair that verifier gap or establish a runtime gain.

raw_artifacts.retention: Temporary artifacts are not a permanent archive; the commands, source hashes, and structured observations are recorded here for reproduction.

claim_boundary: Proven means the existing Oak native checker/verifier's per-body result. This report does not establish original Arm ASL instruction execution, translation/fault equivalence, CAT memory ordering, private-memory custody, BBM publication, or end-to-end formal verification.

runtime.reason: This task ran static code/proof diagnostics and conformance while parallel proof/build work was active. No timing benchmark or C/Rust/Zig performance-parity claim was attempted.
